_about: Component designs for words that have no kanji, written as an inventor of a character would: a semantic part (what it is about) and often a second part that narrows it. Part names come only from the vocabulary the model was trained on (KANJIDIC first meanings of KanjiVG components), so every design is in distribution. Two designs per word, to test that the design, not the word, decides the glyph.
pizza: food, and the crust as a skin
computer: a metal thing that measures, like the metal radical in machine words
algorithm: an ordered thread of measured steps
cryptocurrency: shell money, the radical of money and value, made unreal
